response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), s AS (SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g) SELECT ordertypedist, cnt, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS diff_above_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY share DESC
